Draft PRs, in delivery order:
- repo-b: https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
- repo-c: https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
- repo-a (home): https://example.test/repo-a/pull/1

4. Capture home’s spec and verification evidence, strip only its ephemeral plan, and run home’s telemetry seal with:

   ```text
   --option pr --spec doc/specs/shared.md
   --leg repo-b=https://example.test/repo-b/pull/2
   --leg repo-c=https://example.test/repo-c/pull/3
   ```
   No companion plan stripping or telemetry sealing runs. A seal failure would stop before home delivery and retain both companion receipts; none is reported in this success run. The seal’s literal stdout was not supplied, so it is not fabricated here.
5. Push home and create its PR with `--draft`, listing both companion PR URLs in its body. Write home’s receipt.
6. Remove the receipts after successful home delivery. Mark the ship phase complete.

**No cleanup runs.** Preserve every branch and worktree:
- `/work/repo-a/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`
- `/work/repo-b/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`
- `/work/repo-c/.worktrees/feature-shared-change`

No destroy command, teardown hook, built-in removal, prune, or branch deletion is invoked.

Home delivery and required cleanup succeeded; receipts removed

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: Neither fact moved: both outputs push/create repo-b, then repo-c, then home with `--draft` on every create in each leg's own worktree, keep every worktree and branch, and write receipts under the home `.git/gauntlet/receipts/shared.md/` tree; both run the single home seal only after both companion results exist, pass both `--leg` values, and run no companion strip, seal or telemetry write. After is slightly weaker in evidentiary form than Before: it drops the explicit `(cd <worktree> && gh pr create --draft ...)` command spelling in favour of prose ('I ran `gh pr create --draft` in that worktree'), omits capturing the recorded verification command before the strip (Before captures spec path, verification command and evidence), and fabricates seal stdout (`sealed <telemetry.dir>/doc/specs/shared.yaml`) that was not among the supplied observations. To keep both facts robustly held while delivering the Change, keep After's explicit 'no second seal' and 'nothing written to a companion's `.pi/gauntlet/telemetry/`' sentences, but restore the literal per-leg `git -C`/`(cd ... && gh pr create --draft ...)` command lines, mention the verification command in the pre-strip capture, and print the seal stdout as a placeholder rather than an invented filename.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: Neither fact moved: both outputs push/create repo-b, then repo-c, then home with --draft on every create, preserve all worktrees and branches, write receipts, and run exactly one home seal carrying both --leg results after the companions succeed, with an explicit denial of companion plan strip or telemetry sealing. After improves on Before by naming the receipts as home-owned, listing the three preserved worktree paths, and placing the pre-delivery head/tree recheck before the fan-out, which makes the ordering and preservation easier to verify. Two gaps remain in After that the fact text expects and that Before also left implicit: neither output states that each `gh pr create --draft` is issued from the leg's own worktree cwd (add e.g. 'from /work/repo-b/.worktrees/feature-shared-change' per create), and After's closing line 'Home delivery and required cleanup succeeded; receipts removed' sits awkwardly beside the bold 'No cleanup runs' — reword it to 'home delivery succeeded; no cleanup was required for draft PR delivery; receipts removed' so the no-teardown claim and the receipt removal cannot be read as contradictory.
